views.name: marketplace_stats
views.definition:
SELECT (( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM commission_campaigns
          WHERE commission_campaigns.status = 'active'::text))::integer AS active_campaigns,
    (( SELECT count(DISTINCT agent_campaigns.agent_id) AS count
           FROM agent_campaigns
          WHERE agent_campaigns.status = 'active'::text))::integer AS active_agents,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(agent_commissions.amount), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM agent_commissions
          WHERE agent_commissions.status = 'paid'::text) AS total_paid_commissions,
    (( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM campaign_leads))::integer AS total_leads;
